description: A severe-symptom keyword must escalate to a human deterministically, before the model is ever consulted.

turns.userText: My lips are swelling after using this product

scriptedResponse.content: I understand — please stop using it and seek medical attention.

description: A customer explicitly asking for a human must escalate.

turns.userText: I want to talk to a human, please

scriptedResponse.content: Of course — connecting you with a colleague now.

description: Overt frustration/anger markers must escalate to a human deterministically, before the model is ever consulted.

turns.userText: This is absolutely ridiculous, I've been waiting for weeks and I'm extremely frustrated

scriptedResponse.content: I'm really sorry about the delay — let me get a colleague to help right away.

description: A plain, non-frustrated question must not trip the negative-sentiment scanner.

turns.userText: Hi, can you tell me the status of my order?

scriptedResponse.content: Sure — could you share your order number?
